summary.headline: Astrological Chapters on Birth and Katarchai
summary.text: Chapters 135–152 of an astrological codex cover parents, sex of the unborn, rearing, life periods, bodily form and temperament, injuries and diseases, possessions, dignity, action, marriage, children, friends, foreign travel, death, division of life periods, and Persian katarchai for royal appointments, authority, armies, and benefit from rulers. Ptolemy is repeatedly cited, including Tetrabiblos III.15, with concordance to Codex Venetus 5.
